suspected.en: Notify the CHO surveillance unit immediately and record paralysis onset.
suspected.local: Ipahibalo dayon sa CHO surveillance kag irekord kon san-o nagsugod ang pagkaluya/paralysis.

probable.en: Arrange urgent referral and coordinate two stool specimens through the PIDSR pathway.
probable.local: Ipa-refer gilayon kag koordinahon ang duha ka stool specimen paagi sa PIDSR pathway.

confirmed.en: Activate the CHO rapid response team, complete contact assessment, and support immunization review.
confirmed.local: I-activate ang CHO rapid response team, usisaon ang contacts, kag repasuhon ang immunization status.

cluster.en: Conduct house-to-house active case finding for new weakness or paralysis.
cluster.local: Mag-house-to-house pangita sang bag-o nga kaso sang pagkaluya ukon paralysis.

cluster.en: Create one cluster line list and escalate it to the CHO incident team.
cluster.local: Maghimo sang isa ka cluster line list kag i-escalate sa CHO incident team.

suspected.en: Assess severity, record vaccine details, and notify the immunization coordinator immediately.
suspected.local: Usisaon ang kabug-aton, irekord ang detalye sang bakuna, kag ipahibalo dayon sa immunization coordinator.

probable.en: Arrange clinical referral and preserve the vaccine, lot, and administration records for investigation.
probable.local: Ipa-refer ang pasyente kag tipigan ang vaccine, lot, kag administration records para sa imbestigasyon.

cluster.local: Ikompara ang vaccine lot, site, vaccinator, kag timing sang tanan nga clustered reports.

cluster.en: Maintain one cluster line list and escalate significant patterns to the CHO incident team.
cluster.local: Magtipig sang isa ka cluster line list kag i-escalate ang importante nga pattern sa CHO incident team.

suspected.en: Avoid handling suspect animals or hides, cover lesions, and notify CHO and veterinary authorities immediately.
suspected.local: Indi pag-uyatan ang suspetsado nga sapat ukon panit; tabunan ang lesion kag ipahibalo dayon sa CHO kag veterinary.

probable.en: Coordinate protected specimen collection and urgent clinical referral under infection-control precautions.
probable.local: Koordinahon ang protektado nga specimen collection kag gilayon nga referral suno sa infection-control precautions.

confirmed.en: Activate joint human-animal exposure tracing and secure the suspected source area.
confirmed.local: I-activate ang joint human-animal exposure tracing kag seguruhon ang suspetsado nga source area.

cluster.en: Map shared animal, meat, wool, and hide exposures and stop further distribution.
cluster.local: I-map ang pareho nga animal, karne, wool, kag hide exposure kag untaton ang dugang nga pagpanagtag.

cluster.en: Create a joint One Health cluster line list.
cluster.local: Maghimo sang joint One Health cluster line list.

suspected.en: Provide a mask, separate the patient from crowded areas, and assess testing and referral needs.
suspected.local: Hatagan mask, ibulag anay sa matawo nga lugar, kag usisaon kon kinahanglan testing ukon referral.

probable.en: Coordinate diagnostic testing, household contact listing, and home infection-control guidance.

confirmed.local: Sundon ang pinakabag-o nga DOH isolation, clinical monitoring, kag high-risk contact guidance.

cluster.en: Investigate shared indoor exposure, improve ventilation, and expand symptom surveillance.
cluster.local: Usisaon ang pareho nga indoor exposure, pauswagon ang bentilasyon, kag palaparon ang symptom surveillance.

cluster.en: Maintain one onset-based cluster line list.
cluster.local: Magtipig sang isa ka onset-based cluster line list.

suspected.en: Advise hand hygiene, no sharing of utensils, and temporary exclusion while febrile or acutely ill.
suspected.local: Pahugasi pirmi ang kamot, indi maghulamay utensils, kag magpabilin anay sa balay samtang may hilanat ukon masakit.

confirmed.local: Koordinahon ang facility-wide surveillance kag sundon ang CHO guidance sa class ukon daycare control measures.

cluster.en: Line-list affected children by classroom or daycare group and intensify cleaning and symptom checks.
cluster.local: I-line-list ang apektado nga kabataan per classroom ukon daycare group kag paigtingon ang cleaning kag symptom checks.

cluster.en: Submit a single HFMD cluster line list to CHO.
cluster.local: Isumiter ang isa ka HFMD cluster line list sa CHO.

suspected.en: Mask and separate the patient, document poultry exposure, and notify CHO and veterinary authorities immediately.
suspected.local: I-mask kag ibulag ang pasyente, irekord ang poultry exposure, kag ipahibalo dayon sa CHO kag veterinary.

probable.local: Koordinahon ang gilayon nga respiratory specimen referral kag protektado nga transport sa designated facility.

confirmed.local: I-activate ang One Health contact tracing, poultry-source investigation, kag monitored exposure follow-up.

cluster.en: Maintain a joint human-animal cluster line list.
cluster.local: Magtipig sang joint human-animal cluster line list.

cluster.en: Maintain one contact-linked cluster line list.
cluster.local: Magtipig sang isa ka contact-linked cluster line list.

cluster.local: Magtipig sang isa ka contact-linked meningitis cluster line list.
